Discussion · Give a Welcome Speech as a CEO

Imagine you are the CEO of a cross-border e-commerce firm and you are going to give a welcome speech to the new employees.（想象你是跨境电商公司的 CEO，要为新员工致欢迎辞。）

Step 1 · Think: 从哪些角度构思你的欢迎辞？

👋 ① Greeting & Self-introduction 问候与自我介绍

你是谁？公司叫什么？用热情的开场让新人放松下来。

🏢 ② Company & Business 公司与业务

公司卖什么（product category）？卖到哪些国家/平台？让新人知道自己加入了什么样的团队。

🎯 ③ Vision & Goals 愿景与目标

未来公司想达成什么（做品牌？开拓新市场？）给新人一个共同奋斗的方向。

🤝 ④ Expectations 对新人的期望

你希望他们具备什么品质：好奇心？团队合作？客户第一？敢试错？

🌱 ⑤ Growth & Support 成长与支持

公司能给他们什么：培训、导师、晋升机会？

🥂 ⑥ Closing Wishes 结尾祝福

欢迎加入（welcome aboard）+ 美好祝愿，简短有力收尾。

Once again, welcome aboard, and I wish you ______ (a wonderful journey / great success here). Thank you!

Step 3 · A Sample Speech 欢迎辞范例

Good morning, everyone! Welcome to Sunrise Trading Company. I'm Li Hua, the CEO of the company. It's a great pleasure to see so many new faces joining our cross-border e-commerce family.

As many of you know, we specialize in home and kitchen products, and we sell to customers in Europe and North America through platforms like Amazon and eBay. In the next three years, we aim to build our own brand and expand into the Southeast Asian market.

What we expect from you is curiosity, teamwork, and the courage to try new things. Don't be afraid to make mistakes — every question is welcome here.

Together, we will make Sunrise a name known by customers around the world. Once again, welcome aboard, and I wish you a wonderful journey with us. Thank you!

Text A · Cross-border E-commerce vs. Traditional Foreign Trade

The term "cross-border e-commerce" has become the darling of the media in recent years. And the dispute in the pattern of cross-border e-commerce has lasted a long time. In fact, such arguments are nothing more than confusing cross-border e-commerce with traditional foreign trade. What on earth are the differences between cross-border e-commerce and traditional foreign trade?

1. The Cost Differs

Traditional foreign trade is mainly concentrated on large quantities of goods, and then the goods enter into a multi-level distribution by overseas logistics companies. Finally the goods will eventually reach the end consumers (enterprises or individuals), while cross-border e-commerce is directly facing the end customers.

2. The Process Differs

In traditional trade, the import and export process are cumbersome, while cross-border e-commerce companies require the links be reduced as much as possible. They can even send goods directly to consumers.

3. The Ways of Spread Differ

Traditional trade uses information platforms such as wholesale message, mail, and exhibitions to disseminate information. Cross-border e-commerce companies sell products directly to consumers through platforms such as Amazon, eBay, and Wish.

4. The Model Differs

Because the traditional trade uses information flow to spread, the basic model is B2B, while cross-border e-commerce can reduce intermediate links, therefore the goods is mostly sold directly by the platform. And its main model is B2C.

Obviously, the cross-border e-commerce model and the traditional foreign trade model make a big difference, so what distinguishes traditional foreign trade from cross-border e-commerce models? Cross-border business is divided into import and export. Similarly, cross-border e-commerce model can also be divided into import cross-border e-commerce and export cross-border e-commerce. For import cross-border e-commerce, it is usually the domestic consumers that visit overseas sellers to select goods. After orders are placed, overseas sellers directly send international express delivery to consumers. Export cross-border e-commerce is just the opposite, domestic sellers directly deliver goods to the hands of overseas buyers.

Text B · Benefits of Cross-border E-commerce and Vital Considerations

1. Benefits of Cross-border E-commerce

Doing business online has become more and more commonplace in recent times. In fact, many small scale businesses are using cross-border e-commerce to build exposure and compete with much larger businesses. Here are some of the benefits of cross-border e-commerce.

(1) International Expansion

Cross-border e-commerce benefits both sellers and buyers. On one hand while sellers get to sell their products to international customers without having a brick-and-mortar store in those countries. It is a way to say goodbye to barriers of international trade. Cross-border e-commerce allows businesses to showcase their range of products and earn trust of their target customers by providing good customer service and on-time delivery.

(2) Increased Business Profits

Cross-border e-commerce simply translates into higher chances of selling your products. The more the reach and customers, the higher are sales and revenue. So, ambitious business owners are already getting in touch with cross-border e-commerce software solution provider companies to see an upsurge in business profits.

(3) Increased Brand Awareness

By reaching out to international clients/customers via cross-border e-commerce, brand awareness increases at minimum investment. Brand awareness is the first point of validation in e-commerce, and businesses are not unaware of it.

(4) Enhanced Business Sustainability

Increased reach, expansion, profits, and brand awareness automatically result in increased business sustainability every business strives for. For emerging e-commerce businesses, cross-border e-commerce is the way to increased business sustainability.

2. Vital Considerations for Cross-border E-commerce

(1) Logistics & Delivery Timelines

Timely and safe delivery of products is the backbone of any e-commerce business. As a responsible business, you must take the accountability to deliver the desired product to your customer not only on time but safe as well. Receiving a product late or damaged is enough to drive away your customer and to tarnish your repute. You also need to consider the costing bit when it comes to logistics. The logistics service provider you choose must be reliable and must share the same business value as yours.

(2) Various Payment Methods

Payment methods are different in each country. People living in different countries have different payment method preferences. Visa for instance, holds the biggest market share in terms of credit card in Middle East & Africa. Over the past few years eWallets have also become quite popular. Having a variety of payment methods your customers prefer is an additional advantage to your e-commerce business. A repute online e-commerce software solution provider can help you determine which payment methods you can have on your online store.

(3) Regulation Compliance

Each country having its own taxes and regulations makes the entire process complicated for a business. Careful planning and expert advice can make your life easy. What products can or cannot be delivered is also an important consideration while devising a cross-border e-commerce strategy.

(4) Understand the Local Market

Cross-border e-commerce can take your business to new heights, but are payment methods, taxes, and logistics/delivery the only vital considerations? Understanding the local market of your targeted country, customs, culture, and preferences/taste is also crucial to your cross-border e-commerce business. Offering cost-effective products which are in line with the preferences/taste of the people living in a particular country is the ticket to a progressively growing business.

📖 词汇小结 · Vocabulary（课本生词表）

1. quantity /ˈkwɒntəti/ n. 数量；大量；数目；大批 — eg. Cheap goods are available, but not in sufficient quantities to satisfy demand.

2. exhibition /ˌeksɪˈbɪʃən/ n. 展览；展出；展览品 — eg. The exhibition provides evidence of several new directions in her work.

3. showcase /ˈʃəʊkeɪs/ n. 玻璃陈列柜；展示场合 vt. 使展现 — eg. The thieves smashed the showcase and stole the vase.

4. upsurge /ˈʌpsɜːdʒ/ n. 急剧上升；猛涨 vi. 高涨；涌起 — eg. Almost all countries got involved in the upsurge of the regional economic cooperation.

5. additional /əˈdɪʃənl/ adj. 附加的；额外的 — eg. I have one lock but I bought another as an additional insurance against thieves.

6. progressively /prəˈɡresɪvli/ adv. 逐步地；愈益 — eg. Then you can work progressively and have a sense of achievement whenever you've done with a small part.
